findings.message:
Rubixi (../sb/rubixi.sol#10-162) contract sets array length with a user-controlled value:
	- participants.push(Participant(msg.sender,(msg.value * pyramidMultiplier) / 100)) (../sb/rubixi.sol#61)
findings.name: controlled-array-length

findings.message:
Rubixi.collectPercentOfFees(uint256) (../sb/rubixi.sol#99-105) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- feesToCollect = collectedFees / 100 * _pcent (../sb/rubixi.sol#102)
findings.name: divide-before-multiply

findings.message: Rubixi.collectPercentOfFees(uint256) (../sb/rubixi.sol#99-105) ignores return value by creator.send(feesToCollect) (../sb/rubixi.sol#103)
findings.name: unchecked-send

findings.message: Rubixi.collectFeesInEther(uint256) (../sb/rubixi.sol#89-97) ignores return value by creator.send(_amt) (../sb/rubixi.sol#95)
findings.name: unchecked-send

findings.message: Rubixi.addPayout(uint256) (../sb/rubixi.sol#59-79) ignores return value by participants[payoutOrder].etherAddress.send(payoutToSend) (../sb/rubixi.sol#74)
findings.name: unchecked-send

findings.message: Rubixi.collectAllFees() (../sb/rubixi.sol#82-87) ignores return value by creator.send(collectedFees) (../sb/rubixi.sol#85)
findings.name: unchecked-send

findings.message:
Reentrancy in Rubixi.addPayout(uint256) (../sb/rubixi.sol#59-79):
	External calls:
	- participants[payoutOrder].etherAddress.send(payoutToSend) (../sb/rubixi.sol#74)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balance -= participants[payoutOrder].payout (../sb/rubixi.sol#76)
	- payoutOrder += 1 (../sb/rubixi.sol#77)
findings.name: reentrancy-unlimited-gas

findings.message:
Reentrancy in Rubixi.collectFeesInEther(uint256) (../sb/rubixi.sol#89-97):
	External calls:
	- collectAllFees() (../sb/rubixi.sol#91)
		- creator.send(collectedFees) (../sb/rubixi.sol#85)
	- creator.send(_amt) (../sb/rubixi.sol#95)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- collectedFees -= _amt (../sb/rubixi.sol#96)
findings.name: reentrancy-unlimited-gas
